- Key constraints: must run in our VPC; we need audit logs and token retention policy that meets our security team requirements.

Alex — thanks for the clear summary. Great call. I pulled together a compact plan below that maps owners, timelines, and success criteria so you can share with procurement and infra.

High-level mutual action plan (week-by-week):
- Week 0 (this week): sign evaluation MSA + enable Redwood Private trial (VPC) — owner: NovaWorks procurement (Priya) + Karthik (sales).
- Week 1: VPC provisioning, KMS integration, and baseline network tests — owner: NovaWorks infra (Alex) + Grace (SE).
- Week 2: Integration sprint — SDK quickstart, streaming endpoint tests, and tool-calling smoke tests — owner: Grace + NovaWorks engineers.
- Week 3: Load and latency validation with production-like traces, cost burn projection — owner: Grace + Karthik for reporting.
- Week 4: Success criteria review and decision to expand reserved capacity (Dedicated) or continue hosted path — owner: NovaWorks execs + Redwood CS (Tessa).

Success criteria (must be met to qualify the eval as successful):
- Latency: 95th percentile request-to-first-token <= 250ms for median 1-2k concurrent KV-cached requests; 99th percentile <= 500ms for full-context requests.
- Throughput: sustain 30 RPS for peak scenario in our load harness for 10 minutes without errors.
- Quality: model responses pass your 10 gold prompts (we can add more) and show no regression vs baseline search relevance (precision@10 within 2% of current).
- Tooling: function/tool-calling end-to-end flow (trigger -> tool -> update) completes successfully in < 600ms on average for the 5 canonical flows you described.
- Security: VPC network egress policy applied; KMS integration verified; audit logs accessible for 30 days.

Deliverables we will provide: SDK quickstart, sample streaming integration, tool-calling reference, a brief runbook for VPC setup, and a load harness script.

Next immediate asks from NovaWorks:
1) Signed evaluation MSA (I attached a one-page starter MSA).
2) A list of 2 infra contacts we can work with on VPC peering and KMS (Alex, please confirm).
3) 3 representative user queries for us to build the first gold prompt set.

I'll loop Grace on the technical checklist below — she will propose exact endpoints and payload examples.

Best,
Karthik
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachments: novaworks-mutual-action-plan-20261110.xlsx)

Subject: Technical checklist & sample endpoints for NovaWorks evaluation

Alex / team — following up with a focused tech checklist and sample calls we recommend for your integration sprint. We kept this minimal so your devs can validate quickly.

1) SDK Quickstart
- SDK: redwood-js v1.7 (we'll provide a pinned tarball).
- Quickstart steps: npm install, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, run sample server (instructions attached in redwood-sdk-quickstart.md).

2) Streaming generation (recommended for suggestions):
- Endpoint: POST /v1/generate-stream
- Example: send initial system+user tokens; Redwood will stream incremental tokens and final metadata.
- Success test: confirm first token delivered within 120-250ms under a KV cache hit scenario.

3) Tool calling / functions
- Endpoint: POST /v1/call-function
- Flow: model returns a function call payload -> your tool executes -> tool result posted back via /v1/function-result.
- Test: implement a simple "lookupProduct" tool (returns JSON) and verify 5 canonical tool calls complete end-to-end with overall latency < 600ms.

4) Embeddings & rerank (optional initial step)
- Endpoint: POST /v1/embeddings
- Use for offline relevance evaluation. Provide 200 sample items and we will compute similarity matrices for your team.

5) Observability hooks
- Please enable request IDs in your client. We will add tracing links in Console and provide per-token cost breakdowns.

6) Security / VPC notes
- We'll provide a CloudFormation template for VPC peering plus an HSM/KMS integration guide.

I'll open a short repo with example endpoints and the harness you can run. Proposed pairing session: Mon Nov 16 10:00 AM PST for initial VPC smoke and SDK install. Does that work?

Grace O'Connor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood-sdk-quickstart.md)
